name: Counter
description: A larger threshold counter patch with rows, carry lines, and a reset-like blue inhibit stage.

name: Decimal CPU Counter
description: A hardwired decimal CPU preset: a top-left entry runs FETCH/DECODE/EXECUTE/WRITE rows from 0 to 9, and WRITE clears then sets a persistent seven-segment display.

name: 3bit Ripple Counter
description: Three 1bit memory cells wired as a binary incrementer: each clock reads bit0, writes it, and ripples carry only when a bit was already 1.

name: 4bit Decimal Display
description: Four 1bit memory cells decode a 4-bit value into persistent decimal bar columns. Decode clears the previous display, then latches tens on the left and ones on the right.

name: Three Engines One Key
description: One top-left trigger starts 3, 5, and 7 step loops with light blue braking.

name: Glass Ratchet Key
description: A compact 4/6/9 ratchet with high shimmer and explicit top-left entry.

name: Phase Sieve
description: Three silent rings of length 2, 3, and 5 feed threshold gates that compute phase coincidences at 6, 10, 15, and 30 ticks.
